all_jupiter_midpoints.interpretation: Physical and emotional fulfilment. An essentially positive outlook. Optimism, confidence and resilience. An abundance of creative and procreative energy. Materialistic inclinations. Accumulating assets. Prosperity.

all_saturn_midpoints.interpretation: Frustrated or repressed passions. Challenges and difficulties within love life. Controlling influences within sexual relationships. A risk of disloyalty. Separative influences.

all_uranus_midpoints.interpretation: Thriving on change and stimulation. Rebellious traits. Tensions. Instability. Unpredictable behaviour. Agitation and irritability. Sudden departures or separations.
